name: SDF Ray Marching with Grid Lookup
definition: A GPU-based ray marching algorithm that samples a 3D Signed Distance Function (SDF) grid to find the first intersection point of a ray with the zero-level set (surface). It uses linear interpolation to evaluate the SDF at arbitrary points within the grid bounds.
summary: A GPU ray marching algorithm that samples a 3D SDF grid to find intersections, differing from standard methods by using a pre-computed grid and pixel-wise distance thresholds.
